note: Hand-curated cost-of-living provisos (utility oversight, personal-finance education, tax relief, housing) from Part IB of each enacted appropriations act (term-matched candidate sets in provisos/{year}/). Budget provisos are one-year rules enacted inside the annual budget bill; votes attach to the whole appropriations bill (or a named amendment), never to one proviso. FY 2020-21 had no enacted Part IB (COVID continuing resolution) — stated explicitly per the workflow's none-found rule. Financial-education provisos: none found in any cycle except FY 2022-23 proviso 1.101 (the graduation-requirement order) — an explicit none-found for the other six cycles.

cycles.note: No enacted Part IB this cycle: H5201 died in committee during COVID; the state ran on continuing resolution H3411 plus CARES acts.

provisos.caption: ORS: Natural Gas Rate Stabilization Act Study
provisos.display_caption: ORS: Natural Gas Rate Stabilization Act Study
provisos.why_relevant: Ordered the state utility watchdog to study whether the Natural Gas Rate Stabilization Act — the mechanism letting gas utilities adjust rates yearly outside full rate cases — actually serves ratepayers, reporting by December 31, 2021.

provisos.caption: ORS: Energy Efficient Manufactured Homes
provisos.why_relevant: Kept the energy-efficient manufactured homes purchase incentive running for another year.

provisos.caption: GP: Funds Transferred to Santee Cooper
provisos.display_caption: GP: Funds Transferred to Santee Cooper
provisos.why_relevant: Distributed the money held from the Santee Cooper sale-evaluation process (Act 95 of 2019): $2 million to the Office of Regulatory Staff, $1 million to the Public Service Commission, the balance to Santee Cooper, all for reform work.
provisos.verbatim_figure: $2,000,000 to ORS; $1,000,000 to the PSC; balance to Santee Cooper

provisos.caption: GP: Homestead Exemption Fund
provisos.why_relevant: Suspends subsection (C) of the Homestead Exemption Fund statute (Section 11-11-156) for the year — a recurring budget-side adjustment to how the school-operating property-tax relief fund's rules run.

provisos.caption: GP: Personal Property Tax Relief Fund
provisos.display_caption: GP: Personal Property Tax Relief Fund
provisos.why_relevant: Backstops counties that swapped vehicle/personal property taxes for a local sales tax: if the 2% sales tax falls short, the state Trust Fund for Tax Relief covers the gap.

provisos.caption: SR: Tax Relief Reserve Fund
provisos.why_relevant: Creates a reserve fund, separate from the General Fund, that may only be used to provide tax relief to businesses and individuals as provided by law.

provisos.caption: HFDA: Federal Rental Assistance Administrative Fee Carry Forward
provisos.display_caption: HFDA: Federal Rental Assistance Administrative Fee Carry Forward
provisos.why_relevant: Lets the state housing authority carry forward federal rental-assistance administrative fees to keep running assistance programs.

provisos.caption: SDE: Graduation Requirements
provisos.why_relevant: Ordered the State Board of Education to write a required half-credit in personal finance into the high school graduation regulation — the route by which the citizens' financial-education idea actually became policy after the S16 bill died in conference. One-time proviso; the regulation (Document 5130) took effect May 26, 2023.
provisos.verbatim_figure: Half-credit personal finance graduation requirement ordered into regulation
